title: Cookie Exchange Party Ideas: Rules, Games and Photos | Albums.ink
desc: Cookie exchange party ideas for the holidays: simple rules, invitation wording, games and favors, plus one QR code so every guest can add their photos.
h1: Cookie exchange party ideas for a sweet holiday get-together
lead: Search for “cookie exchange party” and the suggestions are “rules”, “games”, “invitation wording” and “ideas for adults”. Here's a simple plan for a December cookie swap – and an easy way to keep every guest's photos of the cookie table in one place.
body: ## The basic rules
- Each guest bakes one kind of cookie – usually a few dozen, so everyone goes home with a mix.
- Ask guests to tell you their cookie in advance, so you don't end up with six batches of chocolate chip.
- Everyone brings a tin or a box to take cookies home.
- Recipe cards next to each plate save you from a dozen “can I get the recipe?” texts.
- Label anything with nuts or other common allergens.
## Invitation wording
- “Bake a batch, bring your favorite – leave with a dozen kinds. Cookie exchange at our place, Saturday Dec 13, 2 pm.”
- Add how many cookies to bring, a reminder to bring a container and an RSVP date.
## Games and little extras
- A vote for best cookie, prettiest cookie and best family recipe.
- A blind taste test or a “guess whose cookie” round.
- Hot cocoa or a mulled cider station, and a holiday playlist.
- Favors: small boxes, ribbon and printed labels for packing the cookies.
## Every guest photo in one album
Everyone takes pictures of the cookie table on their own phone. With an event album on Albums you collect them in one place:
1. Create the album, e.g. “Cookie Swap 2026”.
2. Put the QR code next to the cookie table or on the recipe card stand.
3. Guests scan it with their phone camera and upload photos and videos in the browser – nothing to install.
4. Turn on Hold guest photos if you want to approve uploads before they appear.
5. Afterwards, download the whole album as one ZIP file.
Guests who upload without signing in appear anonymously. Signed-in guests also get a private draft copy with only their own uploads.

faq: How many cookies should each guest bring?
A common rule is a few dozen of one kind, so everyone can take home a mix. Tell guests the number in the invitation.
What are the rules of a cookie exchange?
Each guest bakes one kind of cookie, brings it to share and takes home a mix from the other guests. Containers and recipe cards help.
Do guests need to install anything for the photo album?
No. They scan the QR code and upload in the browser.
How long are the photos kept?
6 months from the first upload, and the album can be extended.
